title: ZFinal zf generator manifest (v1)
description: Emitted on stdout by `zf crud:sql --json`, `zf g <type> --json` and `zf g port --json`. The contract is additive: consumers MUST ignore unknown keys. `ai_edit_zones` names the only regions a human or AI may hand-edit; the marker strings are the single source of truth shared with tools/zf/codegen.zig.

type.description: zf g type: handler | model | middleware | service | task | port

written.description: false when the target dir was missing; see `error`

error.description: machine-readable failure reason (manifest is still emitted)

files.description: logical name -> path, relative to the modules root

items.description: exact marker text, e.g. "// ai-edit-zone: business rules"
